ledger: station wagon (cream, wood-paneled, roof rack) | nose toward frame-left, driver's side facing camera, on/right of desert road | identical configuration and orientation; framing tightens on driver's window | camera executes one continuous slow orbit + push-in from front-left 3/4 to near-profile; car geometry (grille, hood, cowl, doors, wheel arch under driver's window, B-pillar behind woman) stays self-consistent throughout

woman at driver's window | leaning out of front-left window, arms crossed on sill, body over front wheel arch | same window, same posture, hair streaming rearward (toward back of car) | apparent rotation from near-frontal to profile matches camera orbit, not her turning; no wrong-side emergence

driver's side mirror | chrome stalk mirror on front door, rear half of front door (behind her leaning position) | exits frame-right as camera pushes in | position on front door stays consistent with fore/aft layout; occlusion by frame edge is smooth

antenna | thin mast mounted at cowl base on driver's side of windshield | projects progressively onto windshield glass in frame as camera moves to profile | near-side object correctly renders in front of glass and background at all times

rearview mirror (interior) | hangs from top of windshield, roughly center | remains at top of windshield until it exits top of frame | rendering of its shape shifts early (cross-like blob resolving to mirror) but position is stable; shape/identity aspect is out of scope

desert road | paved two-lane running parallel on car's left (driver) side, yellow dashed centerline, white edge line | remains alongside the car's left in every frame; never swaps sides | centerline dashes enter view as the orbit reveals more of the road surface — geometrically compatible

utility poles | line the far side of the road, receding to the left vanishing point | parade from far distance (frame-left) past the car toward frame-right | monotonic progression consistent with forward translation along the road; always occluded correctly by car body
mountain range / desert scrub | horizon backdrop beyond road and on far side | shifts slowly with parallax, stays behind all foreground | no background-over-foreground errors
hood ornament / front license plate | on nose of car at frame-left | exit frame-left as camera orbits and pushes in | smooth, explained disappearance

occlusion pairs (woman vs B-pillar/rear window; antenna vs windshield; car vs poles/mountains) | nearer surfaces correctly occlude farther ones at start | same ordering holds at end | hair blowing across rear side window is correct since she is outside the car's side plane; no depth-order inversions observed
